items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: No, I'm speaking of Tom Brown, the white trombonist from New Orleans.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, they was playing quite a little bit on Clark Street. I used to play on Clark Street, too. I used to play on Clark Street, too. And I used to come around and sit in, and they could play some nice jazz, too. Was Tom Brown in Chicago at that time?
Well, that was before my time. You mean the saxophone? Tom Brown? No, I'm speaking of Tom Brown, the white trombonist from New Orleans.
Oh. Well, I don't remember. I don't remember. Let's see. It's about the end of the road.
